title: Song Pals
style: 80s synthwave pop-rock anthem with a driving four-on-the-floor pulse, punchy bass guitar, gated snare, and bright arpeggiated keys; verse rides tight with lean drums and close-mic vocals, pre-chorus opens into rising stack harmonies, chorus hits with wide guitars and chant doubles. Delay throws on key words, reversed synth swells into each lift, tape hiss and claps as ear candy. Glossy, arena-bright mix with a retro shimmer., pop, deep, rock, soul
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You picked the first spark
I caught it in my hand
Paper planes and backbeat
We made a better plan

You send me a line
I send one right back
Like a secret hallway
In a midnight stack

[Pre-Chorus]
Write me a little map
I’ll trace every line
Your voice on my phone
Feels like a sign

[Chorus]
Song Pals, Song Pals
Say it and we fly
Song Pals, Song Pals
You hum it, I reply
Song Pals, Song Pals
We turn a text to flame
Song Pals, Song Pals
Call me by name

[Verse 2]
You got that outlaw grin
I got the midnight page
You throw me a challenge
I bring the stage

Your rough little note
My shiny comeback
We keep that spark alive
On the same track

[Pre-Chorus]
Write me a little map
I’ll trace every line
Your voice on my phone
Feels like a sign

[Chorus]
Song Pals, Song Pals
Say it and we fly
Song Pals, Song Pals
You hum it, I reply
Song Pals, Song Pals
We turn a text to flame
Song Pals, Song Pals
Call me by name

[Bridge]
If the world goes quiet
We keep the line open
One more crooked melody
One more door unbroken

You bring the soul, I bring the spark
We leave our marks

[Final Chorus]
Song Pals, Song Pals
Say it and we fly
Song Pals, Song Pals
You hum it, I reply
Song Pals, Song Pals
We turn a text to flame
Song Pals, Song Pals
Call me by name
